name: constitution
truth: US Constitution 1787, 11 pages: preamble; Art. 1 Congress (House, Senate, elections, powers incl. taxes/commerce/war, limits on Congress and States); Art. 2 President (election, qualifications, powers, impeachment); Art. 3 judiciary, treason; Art. 4 States (full faith, new states); Art. 5 amendments; Art. 6 debts, supremacy, oaths, no religious test; Art. 7 ratification by nine States; signatures

name: federalist-10
truth: Federalist No. 10 (Madison, 1787), 6 pages: union guards against faction; faction defined; causes rooted in human nature and unequal property; cannot remove causes, so control effects; majority faction is the danger; a pure democracy cannot cure it, a republic (representation, larger territory) can; large republic better than small; the Union's advantage

name: yellow-wallpaper
truth: The Yellow Wallpaper (Gilman, 1892), 15 pages: a woman confined by her physician husband John to a nursery with yellow wallpaper for a 'rest cure' after childbirth; forbidden to write; obsesses over the pattern; sees a woman trapped behind it; her mind breaks; tears off the paper, locks herself in, creeps around the room; John faints
